Custom 1-5/8 x 14 Solid Brass Push Plate, DJO-1-5/8x14-613

Made of .050" thick high quality solid brass for longevity. Packaged with matching finish brass mounting screws for easy installation. The Push Plate is 1-5/8" wide and 14" long. It is finished in oil rubbed bronze.

Specifications of the DJO-1-5/8x14-613 Solid Brass Push Plate:

  • Plate Height: 14"
  • Plate Width: 1-5/8"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Oil Rubbed Bronze Finish
  • Packaged With Mounting Screws

Sold Individually
